system.description: Using an integrated system of gyroscopes, hydraulics, and high-speed processing, this system gives a Droid greater stability. The Droid gains a +5 stability bonus to checks and Defenses to resist attempts to knock it Prone. This bonus stacks with the bonus provided by the Extra Legs Locomotion System.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
